titulo: Runners self-hosted do GitHub nesta máquina rodam como o usuário dono de ~/.engine-signing
brief: Most urgent gap from the engine-registry trust research (engine-registry/docs/research/2026-11-09-confianca-do-registry-sem-custodia-de-chave.md, section 1). Self-hosted GitHub Actions runners live under C:\actions-runner, are registered to 14 repositories of the same GitHub account and are started at logon by a scheduled task that runs as the same Windows user that owns ~/.engine-signing (the Ed25519 signing keys of the nine engines, plus their encrypted backup). Anyone holding a GitHub token with repo+workflow scope can push a workflow with runs-on: self-hosted to one of those repositories and get a job executed on this PC. Task: determine, with evidence, whether such a job can read ~/.engine-signing (or anything else in the user profile): check the runner service account, any container/WSL isolation, mounted paths, and whether the runners are ephemeral and restricted to specific repositories or workflows. No runner process was alive at the time of the research check. Deliver: a short report with the actual isolation boundary, and if a job can reach the profile, a remediation proposal (dedicated low-privilege local account for the runners with no access to the user profile, ephemeral/JIT runners, runner groups restricted to selected workflows, or removing self-hosted runners from repositories that do not need them). Do not change runner registration, tasks or accounts before the owner approves the proposal. Do not touch ~/.engine-signing.

titulo: mcp-gateway instala o engine-kit pela ponta da main do GitHub
brief: From the engine-registry trust research (engine-registry/docs/research/2026-11-09-confianca-do-registry-sem-custodia-de-chave.md, section 1, path 3). mcp-gateway depends on engine-kit through a github:<account>/engine-registry reference that follows the tip of main. Anyone holding a stolen GitHub token can push to that unprotected main and the next npm install of mcp-gateway pulls the attacker's code, bypassing npm provenance and any future npm staged-publish approval. Task: replace the github: dependency with the published npm package engine-kit pinned to an exact version (check npm view engine-kit versions), keep the lockfile with integrity hashes, and run the mcp-gateway suites to prove nothing changed in behavior. Report the version chosen and the test results.

titulo: Esquema de confiança do engine-registry (D, D estrito, B ou manter)
motivo: Decisão do dono: quanto atrito aceitar (um clique de 2FA por release do kit, atraso de autoatualização, estágio também nos motores) e quem configura o npm só-estágio e as releases imutáveis. É a pendência do board.
